breach.name: SoundCloud
breach.title: SoundCloud
breach.summary: In December 2025, SoundCloud announced it had discovered unauthorised activity on its platform. The incident allowed an attacker to map publicly available SoundCloud profile data to email addresses for approximately 20% of its users. The impacted data included 30M unique email addresses, names, usernames, avatars, follower and following counts and, in some cases, the user’s country. The attackers…

fields.name: Geographic locations
fields.why: Where the account was used, which narrows a person down further than most people expect.

fields.name: Names
fields.why: Turns an anonymous address into an identified person, which is what makes targeted phishing possible.

fields.name: Email addresses
fields.why: The address becomes a confirmed, active target, expect more phishing, better aimed.

fields.name: Usernames
fields.why: A handle links this account to every other place the same handle is used.

fields.name: Avatars
fields.why: Adds detail to a profile that can be assembled from several breaches at once.

fields.name: Profile statistics
fields.why: Adds detail to a profile that can be assembled from several breaches at once.

actions: Expect better-aimed phishing. A message that already knows your name and where you have an account is the whole point of a breach like this.
breach.scale_line: That is roughly everyone in Australia.
